name: Space Marine
bio: Short, green and fully kitted out. Passed every fitness test by standing on a crate.
notes: Drive, 2026-11-02 ("space marine uniform", rigged; the owner's download "Meshy_AI_space_marine_uniform_All_Animations.glb", put on disk by the lead with the owner's approval). A rigged Meshy download ("All Animations": Mixamo joint names, read as Meshy's; its Walking and Running clips are not used). A CC0 Meshy community model that the owner rigged and animated on their Meshy account (licence per the owner, 2 Nov), recorded like WWII Infantry and the clip set's sources (content/clip-sets/shooter.json). It moves with the shared clip set. Despite the download's name it is a short, green-skinned, pointy-eared alien in a red uniform (0.91 m in the download): small; in Soldiers, so its bots take soldier names (a soldiers-only match names every bot as a soldier). Hands: big gloved hands (25-30 cm long at the rig's size) stayed open off the gun (grip audit 9): scale 0.8, curl 1.2. Its big head put the rifle's stock at its mouth: fixes.hold forward 0.06, down 0.1, out 0.08 (head to gun 0.15 m -> 0.29). Audit 4: the shooting palm 7-8 cm off the grip in first and third person (off, fp). Name a placeholder.

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
